items.take: Amrize reported Q3 2026 revenues of $3,771 million versus $3,690 million, net income of $558 million versus $540 million, and diluted EPS of $1.02 versus $0.98. Adjusted EBITDA was $1,076 million versus $1,074 million. It updated 2026 guidance to revenues of $12.2 billion to $12.4 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $2.95 billion to $3.05 billion, so earnings growth outpaced a flat EBITDA line.

items.headline: Bank of Canada raises overnight rate 25 bp to 2.5%; says further hikes possible
items.take: The Bank of Canada raised its overnight rate target by 25 basis points to 2.5%, with the Bank Rate at 2.75% and the deposit rate at 2.45%. It said CPI has been around 3% since April and is expected near 3½% by year-end, and that there could be a need to raise the policy rate further, though Governing Council agreed to proceed carefully. The move follows the Bank's September hold at 2¼%, and the explicit mention of more tightening makes this an energy-inflation response rather than a one-off.
items.source_name: Bank of Canada: Policy rate announcement, Oct. 28, 2026

items.headline: Pilgrim's Pride Q3 net sales $4,653.2M vs $4,759.3M; GAAP EPS $0.49 vs $1.44
items.take: Pilgrim's Pride reported Q3 2026 net sales of $4,653.2 million versus $4,759.3 million, down 2.2%, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.49 versus $1.44. Adjusted EBITDA was $316.3 million, a 6.8% margin, versus $633.1 million a year earlier. Profit fell far faster than sales, which points to a margin squeeze rather than a volume problem.

items.headline: Ryerson Q3 revenue $2,177.8M vs $1,161.5M; diluted EPS $0.61 vs $(0.46)
items.take: Ryerson reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2,177.8 million versus $1,161.5 million, up 87.5%, and net income attributable to Ryerson of $32.0 million versus a net loss of $14.8 million. Adjusted EBITDA excluding LIFO was $115.0 million versus $40.3 million. For Q4 it guided net sales of $1.96 billion to $2.04 billion, with the release including an expected $28 million to $30 million of adjusted EBITDA from Olympic Steel.

items.headline: MediaAlpha Q3 revenue $375.9M vs $306.5M; net income $29.4M; Q4 revenue guide $355M-$375M
items.take: MediaAlpha reported Q3 2026 revenue of $375.9 million versus $306.5 million, up 22.7%, with net income of $29.4 million versus $17.6 million and adjusted EBITDA of $39.5 million versus $29.1 million. It guided Q4 revenue to $355 million to $375 million and adjusted EBITDA to $36.0 million to $39.0 million. Net income grew 66.4% against revenue growth of 22.7%, which points to operating leverage in the quarter.

items.headline: Employers Holdings Q3 net income $11.6M vs $(8.3)M loss; combined ratio 108.4%
items.take: Employers Holdings reported Q3 2026 net income of $11.6 million, or $0.64 per diluted share, versus a net loss of $8.3 million, or $(0.36), a year earlier. Net premiums earned were $160.2 million versus $192.1 million, and the GAAP combined ratio was 108.4% versus 129.7%. A combined ratio above 100% means underwriting costs and losses exceeded premiums earned, so the quarter's profit came despite an underwriting result still short of break-even.

items.headline: Markel Q3 total operating revenues $4,158.2M vs $3,934.5M; adj. operating income $707.4M
items.take: Markel reported Q3 2026 total operating revenues of $4,158.2 million versus $3,934.5 million, up 5.7%. Operating income was $383.2 million versus $1,009.8 million, while adjusted operating income rose to $707.4 million from $621.0 million. The Markel Insurance segment's combined ratio was 92% versus 93%; the gap between operating and adjusted operating income is worth a read of the full release.

items.headline: Enerpac completes SFE Group acquisition for about $472M
items.take: Enerpac Tool Group said it completed its previously announced acquisition of Specialized Fabrication Equipment Group LLC for a purchase price of approximately $472 million, including approximately $452 million in cash. SFE Group had about $170 million of sales and about $44 million of adjusted EBITDA for the twelve months ended March 31, 2026, implying 10.6x trailing adjusted EBITDA per the release. The deal was financed partly with a new $850 million credit facility, with pro forma net debt to adjusted EBITDA of about 2.3x.

items.headline: FOMC holds target range at 3-3/4 to 4 percent in 10-2 vote; Cook, Hammack dissent
items.take: The Federal Reserve said the FOMC voted 10 to 2 to maintain the federal funds target range at 3-3/4 to 4 percent. Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack dissented, preferring a 1/4 percentage point increase. The statement says inflation remains elevated and that the Committee is maintaining ample reserves in the banking system; two dissents in favor of a hike mark a hawkish tilt within the vote.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve Board: FOMC statement, Oct. 28, 2026

items.headline: Alphabet to post Q3 2026 results today; call set for 4:30 p.m. ET
items.take: Alphabet said it will hold its Q3 2026 financial results conference call on Wednesday, Oct. 28 at 1:30 p.m. Pacific (4:30 p.m. Eastern), with the earnings release posted on its investor relations site before the call. A replay will be available on YouTube after the webcast.

items.headline: Vantiva Q3 revenue €436M vs €470M; maintains positive 2026 free cash flow guide
items.take: Vantiva reported Q3 2026 continuing-operations revenue of €436 million versus €470 million a year earlier, down 7.3% at current rates. Broadband revenue was €321 million versus €378 million, while Video was €115 million versus €92 million. The company maintained its full-year 2026 guidance for positive free cash flow; 2025 comparatives were restated for reclassifications.
items.source_name: Vantiva Q3 and nine-month 2026 sales release (GlobeNewswire)

items.headline: SPIE agrees to buy 76% of Austria's SAR Anlagenbau; closing seen early 2027
items.take: SPIE announced an agreement to acquire a 76% stake in SAR ANLAGENBAU GmbH, based in Hausmening, Austria, with managing director Arno Reisinger holding up to 24%. SAR has about 230 employees and around €100 million of revenue for fiscal 2025/26, and the price was not disclosed. Closing is expected at the beginning of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions.

items.headline: Natural Health Trends Q3 revenue $7.56M vs $9.48M; net loss $0.23M
items.take: Natural Health Trends reported Q3 2026 net sales of $7,560 thousand versus $9,477 thousand a year earlier, a decline of 20.2% by our calculation. Net loss was $(232) thousand, or $(0.03) per diluted share, versus $(431) thousand, or $(0.04). The release reports $1,716 thousand of dividends paid in the first nine months of 2026 and leaves future dividends to the Board's discretion.

items.headline: Stellantis Q3 net revenues €37,611M vs €37,206M; net loss €(453)M vs €(4,532)M
items.take: Stellantis reported Q3 2026 net revenues of €37,611 million versus €37,206 million, adjusted operating income of €256 million versus €90 million, and a net loss of €(453) million versus €(4,532) million. Industrial free cash flow was €(4,009) million versus €(4,304) million. The narrowing loss and a 0.7% AOI margin show the recovery is still thin against heavy cash outflow.

items.headline: Stellantis reaffirms 2026 guidance; expects positive industrial free cash flow in 2027
items.take: Stellantis reaffirmed 2026 guidance of a mid-single-digit percentage increase in net revenues and a low-single-digit AOI margin, with improved industrial free cash flow including about €1.6 billion in cash payments related to H2 2025 charges. It also expects positive industrial free cash flow in 2027. With Q3 industrial free cash flow at €(4.0) billion, the guide leaves the burden on Q4 and 2027.

items.headline: Axogen Q3 revenue $75.8M vs $60.1M; net income $2.3M, EPS $0.04
items.take: Axogen reported Q3 2026 revenue of $75.8 million, up 26.2% from $60.1 million, with GAAP net income of $2.3 million, or $0.04 per share, versus $0.7 million, or $0.01 per share. It expects full-year revenue of at least $290 million, including at least $7 million from the BioCircuit acquisition. Excluding that deal, the guide implies at least $283 million of organic revenue.

items.headline: California BanCorp Q3 net income $14.0M, EPS $0.43; NIM 4.61% vs 4.71% in Q2
items.take: California BanCorp reported Q3 2026 net income of $14.0 million, or $0.43 per diluted share, versus $14.3 million, or $0.44, in Q2 and $15.7 million, or $0.48, in Q3 2025. Net interest margin was 4.61% versus 4.71% in Q2, while total deposits rose $117.4 million to $3.48 billion. Deposit growth outpaced loan growth of $53.3 million, but the margin slipped.

items.headline: Ensign Group Q3 revenue $1,484.0M vs $1,296.4M; raises 2026 EPS guide to $7.94-$8.02
items.take: Ensign Group reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $1,484.0 million versus $1,296.4 million, a 14.5% increase by our calculation, with GAAP diluted EPS of $1.76 versus $1.42 and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.03 versus $1.64. It raised 2026 annual earnings guidance to $7.94-$8.02 per diluted share from $7.75-$7.85. The raise is modest relative to the Q3 beat in adjusted EPS.

items.headline: W. P. Carey Q3 AFFO $1.33/share vs $1.25; raises 2026 AFFO guide to $5.23-$5.29
items.take: W. P. Carey reported Q3 2026 AFFO of $1.33 per diluted share versus $1.25, with diluted EPS of $0.61 versus $0.64 and total revenues of $468.3 million versus $431.3 million. It raised and narrowed 2026 AFFO guidance to $5.23-$5.29 from $5.19-$5.27 and set the quarterly dividend at $0.950 per share. Investment volume was $181.9 million in the quarter.
items.source_name: W. P. Carey Q3 2026 results (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Boston Scientific Q3 net sales $5.138B vs $5.065B; GAAP EPS $0.40 vs $0.51
items.take: Boston Scientific reported Q3 2026 net sales of $5.138 billion versus $5.065 billion, up 1.5% on a reported, operational and organic basis, with GAAP EPS of $0.40 versus $0.51 and adjusted EPS of $0.73 versus $0.75. Net sales growth of 1.5% is below the roughly 4.25% reported growth the company now guides for the full year.

items.headline: Boston Scientific guides Q4 net sales down 1%-3%; 2026 adj. EPS $3.16-$3.18
items.take: Boston Scientific expects Q4 2026 net sales to decline approximately 3.0% to 1.0% on both a reported and organic basis, with Q4 adjusted EPS of $0.77 to $0.79. For full-year 2026 it guides net sales growth of approximately 4.25% reported and 3.75% organic, and adjusted EPS of $3.16 to $3.18. A Q4 sales decline guided against 1.5% growth in Q3 marks a step down in the company's own outlook.

items.headline: JLL Q3 revenue $7,281.2M vs $6,510.4M; diluted EPS $6.85 vs $4.61
items.take: JLL reported Q3 2026 revenue of $7,281.2 million versus $6,510.4 million, net income attributable to common shareholders of $319.8 million versus $222.8 million, diluted EPS of $6.85 versus $4.61, and adjusted diluted EPS of $6.76 versus $4.50. It raised its full-year adjusted EPS target range and plans a new $500 million accelerated share repurchase. Revenue grew about 11.8% by our calculation while diluted EPS grew about 48.6%, so profit growth ran well ahead of sales.

items.headline: Oatly Q3 revenue $243.1M vs $222.8M; cuts 2026 adj. EBITDA guide to $16M-$20M
items.take: Oatly reported Q3 2026 revenue of $243.1 million versus $222.8 million, a net loss attributable to shareholders of $27.5 million versus $65.3 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $9.4 million versus $3.1 million. It lowered 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $16 million to $20 million from $25 million to $35 million, citing North American fuel and freight inflation, while keeping constant-currency revenue growth guidance at 8% to 10%. The loss narrowed and revenue grew, yet the profit outlook was cut.

items.headline: Platinum Equity signs agreement to acquire propane distributor EDP
items.take: Platinum Equity said it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire EDP, a Chicago-based propane distributor serving more than 200,000 customers through more than 60 locations in 24 states. Terms were not disclosed, and the deal is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. EDP's CEO is to remain in place after the transition.

items.headline: Shenandoah Telecom Q3 revenue $93.9M vs $89.8M; 2026 capex guide raised to $255M-$275M
items.take: Shenandoah Telecommunications reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $93.9 million versus $89.8 million, a net loss of $9.2 million versus $9.4 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $33.2 million versus $29.7 million. It kept 2026 revenue guidance at $370 million to $377 million and adjusted EBITDA guidance at $131 million to $136 million, but raised net capital expenditures guidance to $255 million to $275 million from $220 million to $250 million. Spending guidance rose while the earnings guidance did not move.

items.headline: Constellium Q3 revenue $2,639M vs $2,166M; diluted EPS $0.84 vs $0.62
items.take: Constellium reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2,639 million versus $2,166 million, net income of $119 million versus $88 million, diluted EPS of $0.84 versus $0.62, and Adjusted EBITDA of $276 million versus $235 million. Revenue rose about 21.8% and diluted EPS about 35.5% by our calculation, even though shipments of 368 thousand metric tons were down 1% from Q3 2025. Revenue rising while shipments fell means the growth did not come from volume.

items.headline: Constellium raises 2026 Adj. EBITDA guide to $1.03B-$1.06B; FCF over $300M
items.take: Constellium said it is raising 2026 guidance and now expects Adjusted EBITDA of $1.03 billion to $1.06 billion, excluding the non-cash impact of metal price lag, and Free Cash Flow in excess of $300 million. The company generated Free Cash Flow of $128 million in the third quarter. The release does not state the prior range, so the size of the raise cannot be measured from the source.

items.headline: Scorpio Tankers Q3 net income $224.3M vs $84.5M; diluted EPS $4.60 vs $1.73
items.take: Scorpio Tankers reported Q3 2026 net income of $224.3 million versus $84.5 million a year earlier, with diluted EPS of $4.60 versus $1.73 and vessel revenue of $266.5 million versus $241.4 million. Net income was about 2.7 times the prior-year figure on revenue growth of about 10.4% by our calculation. Profit grew much faster than revenue in the quarter.

items.headline: Scorpio Tankers lifts quarterly dividend to $0.75 per share from $0.45
items.take: Scorpio Tankers declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.75 per common share, up from $0.45 paid in August 2026, payable December 4, 2026 to holders of record on November 13, 2026. The increase is about 66.7% by our calculation. The step-up comes after a quarter in which net income was $224.3 million versus $84.5 million a year earlier.

items.headline: Radware Q3 revenue $84.4M vs $75.3M; cloud ARR $107M, up 21%
items.take: Radware reported Q3 2026 revenue of $84.4 million versus $75.3 million in Q3 2025, GAAP net income from continuing operations of $4.5 million or $0.11 per diluted share, and non-GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations of $0.32. Cloud ARR was $107 million, up 21% year over year, and revenue rose about 12.1% by our calculation. Cloud ARR grew faster than total revenue.

items.headline: Costamare Q3 revenues $220.4M vs $225.2M; EPS $0.73 vs $0.77
items.take: Costamare reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $220.4 million versus $225.2 million a year earlier, net income from continuing operations of $95.0 million versus $99.4 million, and EPS from continuing operations of $0.73 versus $0.77. Revenue declined about 2.1% by our calculation. The company's declared common dividend of $0.125 per share is payable November 5, 2026.

items.headline: Kirby Q3 revenues $977.2M vs $871.2M; diluted EPS $2.09 vs $1.65
items.take: Kirby reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $977.2 million versus $871.2 million, net earnings attributable to Kirby of $110.8 million versus $92.5 million, and diluted EPS of $2.09 versus $1.65. Revenue rose about 12.2% and EPS about 26.7% by our calculation. Earnings grew faster than sales, which points to operating leverage in the quarter.

items.headline: Kirby narrows 2026 EPS growth guide to 10%-15%, sees upper end
items.take: Kirby narrowed its 2026 diluted EPS growth outlook to 10% to 15% and says it expects results toward the upper end of the range. It also guided operating cash flow of $575 million to $675 million and capital spending of $220 million to $260 million. A narrowed range with an upper-end bias suggests management has visibility into the rest of the year.

items.headline: Franklin Electric Q3 net sales $633.6M vs $581.7M; GAAP EPS $1.35 vs $0.37
items.take: Franklin Electric reported Q3 2026 net sales of $633.6 million versus $581.7 million, diluted EPS of $1.35 versus $0.37, and adjusted diluted EPS of $1.50 versus $1.31. Net sales rose about 8.9% by our calculation. The release raised 2026 guidance to net sales of $2.23 billion to $2.30 billion and adjusted diluted EPS of $4.62 to $4.82.

items.headline: International Paper Q3 net sales $6,197M vs $6,222M; adj. operating EPS $0.37
items.take: International Paper reported Q3 2026 net sales of $6,197 million versus $6,222 million, a diluted net loss per share of $(2.13) versus $(2.09), and adjusted operating EPS (non-GAAP) of $0.37 versus $(0.43). The diluted loss per share from continuing operations was $(2.07) versus $(0.81). The gap between the GAAP loss and the positive adjusted figure shows how much of the quarter sat in items the company excludes.

items.headline: International Paper guides Q4 NA Packaging segment profit $460M-$500M
items.take: International Paper guided Packaging Solutions North America Q4 2026 segment operating profit of $460 million to $500 million and full-year segment operating profit of $1.3 billion to $1.4 billion; adjusted EBITDA is guided at $700 million to $740 million for Q4 and $2.27 billion to $2.31 billion for the year. The company said it no longer provides guidance for Packaging Solutions EMEA. Guidance now covers only the North American segment.

items.headline: Franklin Electric to acquire Challenge Pumps for about US$181M cash
items.take: Franklin Electric entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Challenge Pumps Holdings Pty Ltd, a Perth-based underground mine dewatering provider, for about US$181 million (A$259 million) in cash plus up to US$14 million in contingent consideration. The release cites FY2026 revenue of about US$52 million and EBITDA of about US$18 million, and expects closing in 2026. The price is a multiple of roughly ten times that EBITDA figure by our calculation.

items.headline: Renasant to acquire Commercial Holding Company in deal valued at about $142M
items.take: Renasant agreed to acquire Commercial Holding Company, parent of Commercial Bank & Trust, at 0.8798 Renasant shares per Commercial share, a value of about $142 million based on a $40.29 ten-day average price as of October 26. Commercial had total assets of about $1.1 billion at September 30, 2026, and closing is expected in Q1 2027 subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. The deal adds roughly $1.2 billion of trust and wealth assets under management.

items.headline: Patrick reaffirms LCI merger after LCI receives unsolicited Monomoy proposal
items.take: Patrick Industries reaffirmed its all-stock merger agreement with LCI Industries after LCI told Patrick it received an unsolicited nonbinding proposal from Monomoy Capital Partners. LCI's board said it has a duty to evaluate the proposal and has not changed its recommendation for the Patrick merger. Terms of the Monomoy proposal were not disclosed, so the situation remains open.

items.headline: Hilton Q3 revenues $3,325M vs $3,120M; diluted EPS $2.37 vs $1.78
items.take: Hilton reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $3,325 million versus $3,120 million, net income of $536 million versus $421 million, and diluted EPS of $2.37 versus $1.78 (adjusted for special items: $2.45 versus $2.11). System-wide comparable RevPAR rose 5.8% on a currency-neutral basis. Net income grew faster than revenue, which points to operating leverage in the quarter.

items.headline: Hilton 2026 outlook: adj. EPS $9.07-$9.13; RevPAR up 4.0%-4.5%
items.take: Hilton's full-year 2026 outlook calls for diluted EPS of $8.38 to $8.44, adjusted EPS of $9.07 to $9.13, adjusted EBITDA of $4,060 million to $4,080 million, and system-wide comparable RevPAR up 4.0% to 4.5%. It expects net unit growth of 6.0% to 7.0% and capital return of about $3.5 billion. The RevPAR range sits below the 5.8% Q3 pace, below the Q3 growth rate.

items.headline: Aon Q3 revenue $4,101M vs $3,997M; organic growth 6%; adj. EPS $3.36
items.take: Aon reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $4,101 million versus $3,997 million, up 3%, with organic revenue growth of 6%. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.23 versus $2.11 and adjusted EPS was $3.36 versus $3.05. Operating income slipped to $809 million from $816 million while adjusted operating income rose to $1,106 million from $1,051 million.

items.headline: Lennox Q3 net sales $1,572.5M vs $1,426.8M; GAAP EPS $6.41 vs $7.38
items.take: Lennox reported Q3 2026 net sales of $1,572.5 million versus $1,426.8 million, with GAAP diluted EPS of $6.41 versus $7.38 and adjusted EPS of $6.84 versus $7.38. It cut 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $21.00-$21.50 from $23.00-$24.00 and guides revenue growth of about 6%, including about 5% from completed acquisitions. Sales grew while per-share earnings fell, and the guidance cut signals lower profitability expectations for the year.

items.headline: Generac Q3 net sales $1,294.8M vs $1,114.4M; diluted EPS $1.83 vs $1.12
items.take: Generac reported Q3 2026 net sales of $1,294.8 million versus $1,114.4 million, up 16%, net income attributable to Generac of $109.2 million versus $66.2 million, and GAAP diluted EPS of $1.83 versus $1.12. Adjusted diluted EPS was $2.54 versus $1.83. It raised its 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to about 20.5% to 21.0% from 20.0% to 21.0%, while net sales growth guidance was unchanged at the mid-to-high teens percent range.

items.headline: Parsons Q3 revenue $1,650.5M vs $1,621.7M; backlog $9.36B; narrows guide
items.take: Parsons reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1,650.5 million versus $1,621.7 million, net income attributable to Parsons of $54.2 million versus $64.1 million, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.51 versus $0.59 (adjusted: $0.89 versus $0.86). Total backlog was $9.36 billion versus $8.83 billion a year earlier. It narrowed 2026 revenue guidance to $6.25-$6.45 billion from $6.20-$6.50 billion.

items.headline: Equinor Q3 net operating income $11.95B vs $5.27B; adj. EPS $1.20
items.take: Equinor reported Q3 2026 net operating income of USD 11.95 billion versus USD 5.27 billion in Q3 2025, IFRS net income of USD 2.54 billion, and adjusted earnings after tax of USD 2.86 billion. Total equity production was 2,166 mboe per day, up 2% from Q3 2025, and the quarterly dividend is USD 0.39 per share. Net operating income more than doubled year over year, though IFRS net income is reported on a different basis.

items.headline: EQT Q3 net income $279M vs $336M; diluted EPS $0.44 vs $0.53
items.take: EQT reported Q3 2026 net income attributable to EQT of $279 million versus $336 million a year earlier, with diluted EPS of $0.44 versus $0.53 and adjusted EPS of $0.42 versus $0.52. Total sales volume was 583 Bcfe versus 634 Bcfe, including 21 Bcfe of strategic curtailments. Lower volumes and lower earnings year over year show the curtailments and the year-ago comparison both weighed on the quarter.

items.headline: EQT guides Q4 volume 550-600 Bcfe; net debt $5,474M
items.take: EQT guided Q4 2026 sales volume to 550-600 Bcfe and full-year 2026 to 2,375-2,450 Bcfe. Q3 capital expenditures were $638 million versus $618 million a year earlier, and net debt was $5,473.8 million at September 30, 2026 versus $7,689.5 million at December 31, 2025. The balance sheet is the notable change in the release, while the volume outlook sits below the Q3 level.

items.headline: Renasant Q3 net income $78.9M vs $59.8M; diluted EPS $0.86
items.take: Renasant reported Q3 2026 net income of $78.9 million versus $59.8 million a year earlier, and diluted EPS of $0.86 versus $0.63; adjusted diluted EPS was $0.86 versus $0.77. Total assets were $27.5 billion, and the board approved a new $175.0 million repurchase program effective October 27. Adjusted EPS rising from $0.77 to $0.86 indicates earnings improved beyond the change in one-time items.

items.headline: First Busey Q3 net income $55.8M vs $57.1M; EPS $0.61
items.take: First Busey reported Q3 2026 net income of $55.8 million, or $0.61 per diluted share, versus $57.1 million, or $0.58, in Q3 2025. Portfolio loans were $12.82 billion versus $13.60 billion a year earlier, while total deposits were $15.54 billion versus $15.07 billion. EPS rose even as net income and loans fell, which is consistent with a lower share count.
items.source_name: First Busey Q3 2026 earnings release (company release)

items.headline: Baker Hughes Q3 orders $10,764M vs $8,207M; RPO $46.4B
items.take: Baker Hughes reported Q3 2026 total orders of $10,764 million versus $8,207 million a year earlier, with remaining performance obligations of $46.4 billion, up $6.4 billion sequentially; IET RPO was a record $39.4 billion. Book-to-bill was 1.3 overall and 1.7 for IET, and the company said the results support raising its full-year IET order guidance and Horizon 2 IET order outlook to $50 billion plus. The order book is growing faster than revenue, which points to future revenue conversion rather than current-quarter earnings.

items.headline: Baker Hughes Q3 revenue $8,025M vs $7,010M; GAAP EPS $0.41; adj. EPS $0.70
items.take: Baker Hughes reported Q3 2026 revenue of $8,025 million versus $7,010 million, net income attributable to the company of $411 million versus $609 million, and diluted EPS of $0.41 versus $0.61. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.70 versus $0.68 and adjusted EBITDA was $1,415 million versus $1,238 million; the release attributes the year-over-year revenue increase mainly to the Chart acquisition. Revenue rose about 14% while GAAP EPS fell about 33% by our calculation, so adjusted and GAAP results moved in opposite directions.

items.headline: WM Q3 revenue $6,846M vs $6,443M; diluted EPS $2.05; adj. EPS $2.15
items.take: WM reported Q3 2026 revenue of $6,846 million versus $6,443 million, net income attributable to WM of $820 million versus $603 million, and diluted EPS of $2.05 versus $1.49. Adjusted diluted EPS was $2.15 versus $1.98, and free cash flow was $985 million versus $821 million; the release says 2025 figures were updated for a reclassification of landfill accretion expense. Revenue grew about 6% and GAAP EPS about 38% by our calculation.

items.headline: WM returns $957M in Q3; sees 2026 revenue at high end of $26.275-$26.475B
items.take: WM said Q3 2026 shareholder returns totaled $957 million, made up of $580 million of share repurchases and $377 million of cash dividends. For full-year 2026 it expects revenue at the high end of its $26.275 to $26.475 billion range, adjusted operating EBITDA within $8.15 to $8.25 billion, and free cash flow at the high end of $3.75 to $3.85 billion. Guidance for revenue and free cash flow sits at the top of the existing ranges rather than being raised.

items.headline: Arch Capital Q3 net income $1,025M vs $1,340M; diluted EPS $3.00
items.take: Arch Capital Group reported Q3 2026 net income available to common shareholders of $1,025 million, or $3.00 per diluted share, versus $1,340 million, or $3.56, a year earlier. After-tax operating income was $2.67 per diluted share versus $2.77. Net income was down about 23% and diluted EPS about 16% by our calculation.

items.headline: Arch Capital net premiums written $3,845M vs $3,964M; book value $67.90/share
items.take: Arch reported Q3 2026 net premiums written of $3,845 million versus $3,964 million in Q3 2025, a decline of about 3% by our calculation. Book value per common share was $67.90 at September 30, 2026, which the release says is a 0.2% decrease from June 30, 2026. Lower premiums alongside a slightly lower book value is a modest read on the quarter's underwriting scale.

items.headline: PPG Q3 net sales $4,353M vs $4,082M; diluted EPS $2.02; adj. EPS $2.25
items.take: PPG reported Q3 2026 net sales of $4,353 million versus $4,082 million a year earlier (up about 7% by our calculation). Net income attributable to PPG was $451 million versus $453 million, with diluted EPS of $2.02 versus $2.00; adjusted EPS was $2.25 versus $2.13. Income from continuing operations rose to $473 million from $444 million, so the discontinued-operations line explains the gap to total net income.

items.headline: PPG sets 2026 adjusted EPS outlook of $7.90-$8.10; repurchased ~$150M in Q3
items.take: PPG's release gives full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $7.90 to $8.10 and says it is improving its earnings outlook. For Q4 it expects low single-digit organic sales growth and an adjusted EBITDA margin flat to up 100 basis points year over year. The company repurchased about $150 million of shares in Q3 and about $320 million year to date.

items.headline: Mirion Q3 revenue $277.8M vs $223.1M; GAAP EPS $0.03; orders $340M
items.take: Mirion Technologies reported Q3 2026 revenue of $277.8 million versus $223.1 million a year earlier (up 24.5%), GAAP net income of $7.8 million versus $3.1 million, and GAAP EPS of $0.03 versus $0.01. Adjusted EPS was $0.12, unchanged from a year ago. Orders excluding Paragon and July Certrec results were $340 million versus $209 million, up 62%.

items.headline: Mirion updates 2026 guide: adj. EBITDA $285M-$292M, adj. EPS $0.50-$0.54
items.take: Mirion revised its 2026 guidance to revenue growth of about 24%-25% (from 22%-24%) and organic growth of about 7%-8% (from 5%-7%). Adjusted EBITDA is now about $285 million to $292 million (from $285 million to $300 million), and adjusted free cash flow about $170 million to $185 million (from $155 million to $175 million). Adjusted EPS is guided to about $0.50-$0.54 versus $0.48-$0.55 previously, so the range narrowed rather than moved uniformly higher.

items.headline: Bank of Canada decision and Monetary Policy Report due 9:45 a.m. ET Wednesday
items.take: The Bank of Canada will announce its overnight rate decision and publish its quarterly Monetary Policy Report at 9:45 a.m. ET on October 28, with a press conference by Governor Macklem and Senior Deputy Governor Rogers at about 10:30 a.m. ET. On September 2 the Bank held its overnight rate target at 2.25%, with the Bank Rate at 2.5%, citing higher upside inflation risks and new tariffs. This is the first decision since that hold and comes with updated projections.
items.source_name: Bank of Canada: rate announcement and MPR, Oct 28, 2026

items.headline: LPL Financial Q3 revenue $5,344M vs $4,552M; GAAP EPS $4.52; adj. EPS $5.97
items.take: LPL Financial reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $5,344.0 million versus $4,552.0 million a year earlier (up 17% by our calculation), net income of $357 million and GAAP diluted EPS of $4.52 versus a loss of $0.37 in Q3 2025. Adjusted EPS rose 15% to $5.97 from $5.20. The year-ago quarter carried $538 million of acquisition costs versus $83 million this quarter, which flatters the GAAP comparison.

items.headline: LPL total client assets $2,564.6B; organic net new assets $29.1B in Q3
items.take: LPL said total client assets were $2,564.6 billion at quarter-end versus $2,314.5 billion a year earlier, an 11% increase, with advisory assets of $1,561.0 billion and brokerage assets of $1,003.6 billion. Total organic net new assets were $29.1 billion versus $32.7 billion in Q3 2025, and recruited assets were $24 billion, down 26% from a year ago. Asset growth continued while organic inflows slowed from the prior-year quarter.

items.headline: Expand Energy Q3 net income $519M vs $547M; production 7.54 Bcfe/d
items.take: Expand Energy reported Q3 2026 total revenues and other of $3,286 million versus $2,966 million, net income of $519 million versus $547 million, and diluted EPS of $2.24 versus $2.28. Adjusted net income was $338 million versus $234 million, and net production was 7.54 Bcfe/d versus 7.33 Bcfe/d, 92% natural gas. Higher volumes and a wider non-GAAP profit contrasted with slightly lower GAAP earnings.

items.headline: Expand Energy updates 2026 capex guide to ~$3B; repurchased $305M in Q3
items.take: Expand Energy said it updated its 2026 capital investment guidance to approximately $3 billion, with 11-12 rigs and average production of 7.45-7.55 Bcfe/d. It repurchased $305 million of stock in Q3 and has $1 billion of remaining capacity under its expanded authorization, and declared a base dividend of $0.575 per share payable December 3. The release does not state the prior capex figure.

items.headline: EXL raises 2026 revenue guide to $2.430B-$2.440B; Q3 revenue $634.0M
items.take: EXL reported Q3 2026 revenues of $634.0 million versus $529.6 million, GAAP diluted EPS of $0.45 versus $0.36 and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.62 versus $0.48. It now expects 2026 revenue of $2.430-$2.440 billion, up from $2.390-$2.415 billion, and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.34-$2.36, up from $2.25-$2.29. Both revenue and per-share results rose year over year, and the full-year ranges moved higher.

items.headline: Caesars Q3 net revenues $2,940M vs $2,869M; net loss $(123)M
items.take: Caesars Entertainment reported Q3 2026 net revenues of $2,940 million versus $2,869 million, a net loss attributable to Caesars of $123 million versus $55 million, and a diluted loss per share of $0.61 versus $0.27. Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA was $865 million versus $884 million; segment net revenues were $930 million in Las Vegas versus $952 million and $1,627 million in Regional versus $1,536 million. Revenue edged up while the loss widened.
items.source_name: Caesars Entertainment Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: NXP Q3 revenue $3,786M vs $3,173M; GAAP EPS $3.48 vs $2.48
items.take: NXP reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3,786 million versus $3,173 million a year earlier (up 19% by our calculation), with GAAP diluted EPS of $3.48 versus $2.48 and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $4.20 versus $3.11. Revenue and per-share earnings both rose by double digits, a broad gain in the chipmaker's results.

items.headline: NXP guides Q4 revenue $3,750M-$3,950M; announces $5B buyback authorization
items.take: NXP's Q4 2026 revenue guidance is $3,750 million to $3,950 million (midpoint $3,850 million), with non-GAAP diluted EPS guided to $4.14-$4.58. The release also cites a newly announced $5 billion share repurchase authorization. The guidance midpoint sits above Q3's $3,786 million, pointing to continued sequential growth if realized.

items.headline: CoStar Q3 revenue $952M vs $834M; net income $74M vs $(31)M loss
items.take: CoStar reported Q3 2026 revenue of $952 million versus $834 million a year earlier (up 14% by our calculation), net income of $74 million versus a $31 million loss, and diluted EPS of $0.18 versus $(0.07). Adjusted EBITDA was $229 million versus $114 million. Earnings swung to a profit on revenue growth, a sharp improvement in profitability.

items.headline: CoStar raises 2026 adjusted EBITDA guide to $820M-$840M; revenue $3.75B-$3.77B
items.take: CoStar now guides full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA to $820 million to $840 million, up $30 million at the midpoint from its July guidance, and revenue to $3.75 billion to $3.77 billion. A midpoint raise just one quarter after the prior outlook signals management sees profit running ahead of its earlier plan.

items.headline: Slide Insurance Q3 revenue $361.1M vs $265.7M; net income $138.2M vs $111.0M
items.take: Slide Insurance Holdings reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $361.1 million versus $265.7 million (up 36% by our calculation), net income of $138.2 million versus $111.0 million, and diluted EPS of $1.09 versus $0.79. Revenue grew faster than net income, so margins narrowed versus the year-ago quarter.

items.headline: Slide Insurance lifts 2026 net income guide to $500M-$520M from $455M-$470M
items.take: Slide raised its full-year 2026 net income expectation to $500 million-$520 million from a prior $455 million-$470 million, and says the range includes up to $50 million of pre-tax losses tied to Hurricane Isaias in Q4. The raise lifts the midpoint by about $55 million, even after allowing for that storm-loss estimate.

items.headline: First Commonwealth Q3 net income $44.9M, EPS $0.45; adds $25M buyback
items.take: First Commonwealth reported Q3 2026 net income of $44.9 million and diluted EPS of $0.45, versus $44.6 million and $0.44 in Q2. The board declared a $0.14 quarterly dividend payable Nov. 20 to holders of record Nov. 6 and authorized an additional $25 million share repurchase program. Earnings were nearly flat sequentially.

items.headline: Robinhood Q3 revenue $1,424M vs $1,274M; net income $476M vs $556M
items.take: Robinhood reported Q3 2026 total net revenues of $1,424 million versus $1,274 million a year earlier (up 12% by our calculation), net income of $476 million versus $556 million, and diluted EPS of $0.51 versus $0.61. Funded Customers reached 28.7 million and Total Platform Assets $396 billion. Revenue grew while profit fell, so costs and other items outpaced the top line this quarter.

items.headline: Robinhood trims top of 2026 adj. opex and SBC outlook to $2.675B-$2.75B
items.take: Robinhood lowered the top end of its 2026 Adjusted Operating Expenses and SBC outlook by $25 million, to $2.675 billion-$2.75 billion from $2.675 billion-$2.775 billion. The outlook excludes provision for credit losses, costs related to pending acquisitions, and potential significant regulatory matters. The company gave no 2026 outlook for total operating expenses, so the range covers only part of its cost base.

items.headline: BXP Q3 FFO $1.89/share vs $1.74; 2026 FFO guide $7.06-$7.08
items.take: BXP reported Q3 2026 FFO of $1.89 per diluted share versus $1.74 a year earlier, total revenue of $911.4 million versus $871.5 million, and net income attributable to BXP of $0.71 per diluted share versus a loss of $0.77. Its 2026 FFO per diluted share guidance is $7.06 to $7.08, a midpoint of $7.07. A $0.05 higher midpoint implies a prior midpoint near $7.02, per our calculation from the release.

items.headline: BXP portfolio 89.4% occupied, 91.9% leased at Sept. 30; 74 leases signed in Q3
items.take: BXP said total portfolio occupancy was 89.4% at Sept. 30, 2026, up 100 basis points from Q2, with 91.9% leased, up 60 basis points. It executed 74 leases totaling about 1.2 million square feet in Q3 with a weighted-average term of 10.3 years. The 250 basis point gap between leased and occupied space represents about 1.1 million square feet of future lease commencements.

items.headline: QNB Corp Q3 GAAP loss $14.8M on restructuring; adj. net income $7.2M
items.take: QNB Corp reported a Q3 2026 GAAP net loss of $14,774,000, or $(2.67) per diluted share, versus net income of $3,648,000 a year earlier, reflecting a $27,713,000 net loss from a balance sheet restructuring. Adjusted (non-GAAP) net income was $7,207,000, or $1.30 per share, and tax-equivalent NIM was 3.25% versus 2.72%. Total assets were $2.36 billion at Sept. 30 versus $1.91 billion at Dec. 31, 2025, with Victory Bancorp (closed April 1, 2026) in the base.

items.headline: Range Resources Q3 net income $175.3M vs $144.3M; production 2.50 Bcfe/d
items.take: Range reported Q3 2026 GAAP net income of $175.3 million, or $0.75 per diluted share, versus $144.3 million and $0.60 a year earlier; total revenues and other income were $842.8 million versus $748.5 million, up 12.6% by our calculation. Production averaged 2,499,104 mcfe per day versus 2,227,831, and net debt was about $794 million at Sept. 30 versus about $1,218 million at Dec. 31, 2025. Cash generation grew faster than revenue, a pattern worth watching as the EQT merger moves toward closing.

items.headline: Range will not host Q3 call because of pending merger with EQT
items.take: Range's Q3 release describes a "pending transaction with EQT Corporation" and states that, due to the pending merger, it will not host a conference call or webcast. It also reported no share repurchases in the quarter, with $1.4 billion of authorization remaining. With no call, the release and the merger filings become the main disclosure channels.

items.headline: National Bank Holdings reports Q3 net loss of $8.8M; NIM 4.00%
items.take: National Bank Holdings reported a Q3 2026 net loss of $8.8 million, or $(0.20) per diluted share, versus net income of $26.5 million ($0.58) in Q2 and $35.3 million ($0.92) in Q3 2025. Net interest margin (FTE) was 4.00% versus 3.94% in Q2 and 3.98% a year earlier, and total assets were $12.73 billion versus $10.15 billion at Sept. 30, 2025. The margin held up while the bottom line turned negative, so the drivers sit below net interest income.

items.headline: American Assets Trust Q3 FFO $0.56/share vs $0.49; raises 2026 FFO range
items.take: American Assets Trust reported Q3 2026 FFO of $0.56 per diluted share versus $0.49, and net income of $0.13 per diluted share versus $0.07. Total revenue was $114.3 million versus $109.6 million, up 4.3% by our calculation. The company raised 2026 FFO guidance to $2.04-$2.10 from $1.96-$2.10, with office occupancy at 85.8% versus 81.9% a year earlier.

items.headline: Orion Group Q3 revenue $256.2M vs $225.1M; backlog $645M; guide reiterated
items.take: Orion Group Holdings reported Q3 2026 revenue of $256.2 million versus $225.1 million, up 13.8% by our calculation, with GAAP net income of $5.5 million versus $3.3 million and diluted EPS of $0.14 versus $0.08. Adjusted EBITDA was $17.9 million versus $13.1 million, and backlog was $645 million at Sept. 30 versus $640 million at Dec. 31, 2025. The company reiterated 2026 revenue guidance of $900-$950 million.

items.headline: Pharming Q3 revenue $117.6M vs $97.3M; tightens 2026 guide to $380-$390M
items.take: Pharming reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $117.6 million versus $97.3 million, up 20.9% by our calculation, with Joenja revenue of $23.8 million and a net profit of $22.4 million versus $7.5 million. Cash stood at $190.9 million, and 2026 revenue guidance was tightened to $380-$390 million from $375-$395 million. Phase II topline data in the broader CVID population is expected in November 2026.

items.headline: DMC Global Q3 sales $172.8M vs $151.5M; net income $9.7M vs loss of $3.1M
items.take: DMC Global reported Q3 2026 net sales of $172.8 million versus $151.5 million, up 14.1% by our calculation, and net income attributable to DMC of $9.7 million, or $0.59 per diluted share, versus a net loss of $3.1 million. Adjusted EBITDA attributable to DMC was $19.0 million including $5.4 million of tariff refunds, versus $8.6 million. Q4 sales are guided to $154-$164 million.

items.headline: Freddie Mac to report Q3 results before the open Thursday, Oct. 29
items.take: Freddie Mac said it will report third-quarter 2026 financial results before U.S. markets open on Thursday, Oct. 29, 2026, with a media webcast at 9 a.m. ET. The company's results are one of the few direct looks at the mortgage-finance system's earnings this week.

items.headline: Coca-Cola Q3 revenue $13,380M vs $12,455M; GAAP EPS $0.93 vs $0.86
items.take: Coca-Cola reported Q3 2026 net operating revenues of $13,380 million versus $12,455 million a year earlier, up 7%, with organic revenue growth of 7% and unit case volume up 5%. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.93 versus $0.86, and comparable EPS was $0.91, up 11%. Volume and pricing both appear to be supporting the top line, though the release leads with organic growth.

items.headline: Coca-Cola lifts 2026 outlook: comparable EPS growth at least 11%, FCF at least $13.0B
items.take: Coca-Cola now expects 2026 organic revenue growth of at least 5% (prior: approximately 5%) and comparable EPS growth of at least 11% (prior: 9% to 10%). Free cash flow is now expected to be at least $13.0 billion versus approximately $12.4 billion previously, with an underlying effective tax rate of 19.7%. Each of the four targets was revised in the favorable direction.

items.headline: IQVIA Q3 revenue $4,428M vs $4,100M; adj. EPS $3.34 vs $3.00; guide raised
items.take: IQVIA reported Q3 2026 revenue of $4,428 million versus $4,100 million, up 8.0%, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.10 versus $1.93 and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.34 versus $3.00. Net new bookings were $3.2 billion, a 1.2x book-to-bill, and full-year 2026 guidance is now revenue of $17,350 million to $17,500 million and adjusted EPS of $12.90 to $13.00. R&DS contracted backlog stood at $32.6 billion after an approximately $2.1 billion adjustment for inactive trials, a reminder that bookings strength and backlog quality are separate questions.

items.headline: SoFi Q3 net revenue $1,385M vs $962M; net income $241M; members 17.1M
items.take: SoFi reported Q3 2026 total net revenue of $1,385.1 million versus $961.6 million a year earlier, up 44%, with GAAP net income of $241.0 million versus $139.4 million and diluted EPS of $0.18 versus $0.11. Members reached 17.1 million versus 12.6 million, and products reached nearly 26.7 million versus 18.6 million. Member and product growth ran at 35% and 44%, respectively.

items.headline: SoFi raises 2026 view: adj. net revenue about $5.04B, net income about $840M
items.take: SoFi's raised 2026 guidance calls for adjusted net revenue of approximately $5.04 billion, net income of approximately $840 million, and EPS of approximately $0.61. Management continues to expect total members to rise by at least 30% year over year. Q3 adjusted net revenue was $1,371 million.

items.headline: Novartis Q3 net sales $14,522M vs $13,909M; core EPS $2.46; raises core op income view
items.take: Novartis reported Q3 2026 net sales of $14,522 million versus $13,909 million, up 4% in both USD and constant currencies, and core operating income of $6,036 million, up 11%. Core EPS was $2.46 versus $2.25, while IFRS net income was $1,196 million versus $3,930 million and EPS $0.63 versus $2.04. Full-year core operating income is now expected to be in line to grow low single digit in constant currencies, versus a low single-digit decline previously; the gap between IFRS and core results is large this quarter and worth reading in the release's reconciliation.

items.headline: Royal Caribbean Q3 revenue $5,591M vs $5,139M; adj. EPS $6.57 vs $5.75
items.take: Royal Caribbean reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $5,591 million versus $5,139 million a year earlier, net income of $1,735 million, and diluted EPS of $6.45 versus $5.74. Adjusted EPS was $6.57 versus $5.75, and the company now expects full-year 2026 adjusted EPS of $17.85 to $17.95. Revenue grew about 8.8% year over year, with earnings growing faster than sales.
items.source_name: Royal Caribbean Group Q3 2026 results (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Invesco Q3 operating revenues $1,873.2M vs $1,640.4M; AUM $2,537.8B
items.take: Invesco reported Q3 2026 operating revenues of $1,873.2 million versus $1,640.4 million, diluted EPS of $0.65 versus $0.66, and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.72 versus $0.61. Total assets under management were $2,537.8 billion at September 30, with net long-term flows of $35.1 billion in the quarter. Revenue rose about 14.2% year over year while GAAP EPS was roughly flat.

items.headline: CMS Energy Q3 adj. EPS $1.44 vs $0.93; reaffirms 2026 guide $3.83-$3.90
items.take: CMS Energy reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.44 versus $0.93 a year earlier, while reported EPS was $0.39 versus $0.92. It reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $3.83 to $3.90 and 2027 guidance of $4.08 to $4.17. The wide gap between reported and adjusted EPS is worth reading against the company's reconciliation.

items.headline: Itron Q3 revenue $599M vs $582M; non-GAAP EPS $1.94 vs $1.54
items.take: Itron reported Q3 2026 revenue of $599.3 million versus $581.6 million, GAAP diluted EPS of $1.61 versus $1.41, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.94 versus $1.54. It guided Q4 revenue to $621 million to $636 million and full-year 2026 revenue to $2.37 billion to $2.385 billion. Revenue rose about 3.0% year over year, with profit growing much faster.

items.headline: Repligen Q3 revenue $209.3M vs $188.8M; sets FY revenue guide $844-$852M
items.take: Repligen reported Q3 2026 revenue of $209.3 million versus $188.8 million, a GAAP diluted loss of $0.68 per share versus EPS of $0.26, and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.53 versus $0.46. Full-year 2026 guidance is for revenue of $844 million to $852 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.05 to $2.09. Revenue rose about 10.9% year over year while GAAP results swung to a loss.

items.headline: ASM International Q3 revenue €1,159.4M vs €800.0M; operating margin 32.7%
items.take: ASM International reported Q3 2026 revenue of €1,159.4 million versus €800.0 million in Q3 2025 (45% reported, 44% at constant currency) and €1,003.1 million in Q2. Operating margin was 32.7% versus 30.3% a year earlier, and gross margin was 52.0%. Revenue rose far faster than costs, lifting margins on a year-over-year basis.

items.headline: ASM guides Q4 revenue €1,230M ±5%; 2027 revenue seen above €5.7B
items.take: ASM said it expects Q4 2026 revenue of €1,230 million +/-5% at constant currencies, full-year 2026 revenue up approximately 35%, and 2027 revenue of more than €5.7 billion. It also authorized a new share buyback of up to €300 million. The 2027 projection is stated as company guidance, not an outcome.

items.headline: Galaxy Q3 net income $323M vs Q2 loss of $85M; diluted EPS $0.66
items.take: Galaxy Digital reported Q3 2026 net income of $323 million versus a net loss of $85 million in Q2, with diluted EPS of $0.66. Adjusted EBITDA was $455 million versus negative $77 million in Q2. The release compares against Q2, so the swing reflects a quarter-over-quarter turnaround, not a year-over-year gain.

items.headline: Galaxy data centers Q3 adj. gross profit $79M vs $20M; $3.5B notes for Helios
items.take: Galaxy's Data Centers segment posted Q3 adjusted gross profit of $79 million versus $20 million in Q2, and total assets rose to $16.4 billion from $10.8 billion. The company completed a $3.5 billion senior secured notes offering to fund construction of Helios I, Phase II. The balance sheet is expanding alongside its data-center build-out.

items.headline: Sherwin-Williams Q3 sales $6.86B vs $6.36B; net income down 1.5%
items.take: Sherwin-Williams reported Q3 2026 consolidated net sales of $6,860.0 million versus $6,358.2 million, up 7.9%. Diluted EPS was $3.38 versus $3.35 and net income was $821.0 million versus $833.1 million. Sales grew faster than profit in the quarter, with per-share earnings roughly flat.

items.headline: Sherwin-Williams narrows 2026 adjusted EPS guide to $11.85-$12.15
items.take: Sherwin-Williams narrowed full-year 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $11.85 to $12.15 and revised diluted EPS guidance to $10.92 to $11.22. It expects full-year net sales up a mid to high-single-digit percentage and a mid-single-digit increase in the fourth quarter. A narrower range signals less uncertainty about the year-end outcome than a wide one does.

items.headline: BCE: La Caisse to buy 49.9% of Bell tower company for C$2.45B
items.take: Bell Canada and La Caisse announced a partnership under which La Caisse will acquire a 49.9% stake in TowerCo, a newly formed wireless tower company, for C$2.45 billion subject to customary adjustments, which the release says values TowerCo at about C$4.91 billion. Bell keeps a 50.1% controlling interest, and closing is expected in Q1 2027 pending regulatory approvals. The structure raises capital while keeping control of the towers.

items.headline: ENEOS Holdings completes acquisition of TPC Group
items.take: TPC Group announced the completion of its acquisition by ENEOS Holdings, Inc. in a release dated Oct. 27, 2026. The release excerpt reviewed does not disclose a purchase price. The completed transaction moves TPC Group into ENEOS ownership.

items.headline: CTS Q3 sales $149.6M, diluted EPS $0.61 vs $0.46; raises 2026 outlook
items.take: CTS reported Q3 2026 sales of $149.6 million versus $143.0 million, net income of $17.8 million versus $13.7 million, and diluted EPS of $0.61 versus $0.46. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.77 versus $0.60. It raised 2026 sales guidance to $580-$590 million from $565-$585 million and adjusted EPS guidance to $2.78-$2.88 from $2.55-$2.70.

items.headline: Simpson Manufacturing Q3 net sales $638.1M vs $623.5M; EPS $2.68
items.take: Simpson Manufacturing reported Q3 2026 net sales of $638.1 million, up 2.3% from $623.5 million, and diluted EPS of $2.68 versus $2.58. Net income was $109.1 million versus $107.4 million, and adjusted EBITDA was $167.2 million versus $155.7 million. The company estimates 2026 consolidated operating margin of 20.0% to 20.5%, including a projected $11.0 million land-sale gain now expected in Q4.
items.source_name: Simpson Manufacturing Q3 2026 earnings release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: First Financial Corp Q3 EPS $2.31 vs $1.75; net interest margin 4.51%
items.take: First Financial Corporation reported Q3 2026 net income of $27.4 million, or $2.31 per diluted share, versus $20.8 million, or $1.75, in Q3 2025. Net interest margin was 4.51% versus 4.25% a year earlier, and net interest income was $63.5 million versus $54.6 million. The release notes a pending merger with First Illinois Corporation expected to close in Q1 2027. Both net interest income and margin rose year over year in the figures shown.
items.source_name: First Financial Corporation Q3 2026 earnings release (GlobeNewswire)

items.headline: Central Bancompany Q3 net income $116.2M vs $97.1M; NIM 4.48%
items.take: Central Bancompany reported Q3 2026 net income of $116.2 million, or $0.48 per diluted share, versus $97.1 million, or $0.44, in Q3 2025. Net interest margin was 4.48% versus 4.36% a year earlier, and total assets were about $20.2 billion at Sept. 30, 2026. The release describes the results as preliminary and the tables as unaudited.

items.headline: Camden National Q3 EPS $1.34 vs $1.25; net interest margin 3.41%
items.take: Camden National Corporation reported Q3 2026 net income of $22.8 million, or $1.34 per diluted share, versus $21.2 million, or $1.25, in Q3 2025. Fully taxable equivalent net interest margin was 3.41% versus 3.16% a year earlier, while total loans were $5.0 billion, essentially flat from Sept. 30, 2025. Earnings growth here came from margin expansion rather than loan growth, based on those figures.
items.source_name: Camden National Corporation Q3 2026 release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Independent Bank Corp Q3 EPS $0.80 vs $0.84; total assets $6.26B
items.take: Independent Bank Corporation reported Q3 2026 net income of $17.9 million, or $0.80 per diluted share, versus $17.5 million, or $0.84, in the prior-year period. Net interest margin rose to 3.79% from 3.51%, and total assets were $6.26 billion at Sept. 30, 2026 versus $5.66 billion at June 30. Net income edged higher while per-share earnings fell, which the figures shown suggest reflects a larger share count.

items.headline: SNDL Q3 net revenue C$238.0M vs C$244.2M; net loss C$50.8M
items.take: SNDL reported Q3 2026 net revenue of C$237,994 thousand versus C$244,219 thousand a year earlier, a 2.5% decline. Net loss was C$50,789 thousand versus C$13,319 thousand, and adjusted EBITDA (non-IFRS) was C$15,816 thousand versus C$18,075 thousand. Cash and cash equivalents were C$132,479 thousand at Sept. 30, 2026 versus C$252,243 thousand at Dec. 31, 2025.

items.headline: ITW Q3 revenue $4,236M vs $4,059M; GAAP EPS $3.00 vs $2.81
items.take: ITW reported Q3 2026 operating revenue of $4,236 million versus $4,059 million a year earlier, with GAAP EPS of $3.00 versus $2.81. Organic growth was 3.8% and operating margin was 27.8%, up 40 basis points. The release says a tornado at the Welding business reduced revenue by an estimated $40 million.

items.headline: ITW narrows 2026 GAAP EPS guide to $11.45-$11.55; organic growth 3-4% kept
items.take: ITW said it raised its full-year 2026 GAAP EPS guidance by $0.05 at the midpoint to a narrowed range of $11.45 to $11.55. It reaffirmed organic growth of 3% to 4%. The guidance change is a midpoint move within a narrowed range rather than a change in the growth outlook.

items.headline: Ares Capital to acquire MidCap Financial Investment; EV about $2.6B
items.take: Ares Capital agreed to acquire MidCap Financial Investment Corporation (MFIC) for total consideration of $10.88 per fully diluted MFIC share, about $1.21 in cash from an Ares Management subsidiary and about $9.67 in Ares Capital stock, adjusted for a special dividend. The release cites a total enterprise value of approximately $2.6 billion and expects closing in the first half of 2027, subject to MFIC stockholder and regulatory approvals. Business development company consolidation like this concentrates more private-credit assets under larger platforms.
items.source_name: Ares Capital press release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Oct. 27, 2026)

items.headline: Guidewire to acquire hyperexponential for $1.7B cash plus up to $400M contingent
items.take: Guidewire signed a definitive agreement to acquire London-based hyperexponential, an underwriting and pricing software provider for commercial P&C insurers, for a base price of $1.7 billion in cash plus up to $400 million of contingent consideration tied to recurring revenue targets. Funding is $1.0 billion of new term loan financing plus existing cash, and closing is expected in the second quarter of Guidewire fiscal 2027. The deal pairs core insurance software with an existing technology partner.

items.headline: Ares Capital Q3 GAAP EPS $0.44 vs $0.57; core EPS $0.46; NAV $19.31
items.take: Ares Capital reported Q3 2026 GAAP earnings of $0.44 per share versus $0.57 a year earlier and core EPS of $0.46 versus $0.50. Total investment income was $763 million versus $782 million, and net asset value per share was $19.31 at Sept. 30, 2026 versus $19.94 at Dec. 31, 2025. Lower investment income year over year shows pressure on spreads and base rates in direct lending.
items.source_name: Ares Capital press release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1, Oct. 27, 2026)

items.headline: Euronet Q3 revenue $1,161.1M vs $1,145.7M; adj. EPS $3.55 vs $3.62
items.take: Euronet reported Q3 2026 revenues of $1,161.1 million versus $1,145.7 million, diluted EPS of $2.53 versus $2.75, and adjusted EPS of $3.55 versus $3.62. Adjusted EBITDA was $226.1 million versus $244.6 million. The company revised its outlook to approximately $4.375 billion of revenue, approximately $725 million of adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPS growth of approximately 10%, replacing targets from its May Investor Day.

items.headline: Centene Q3 revenue $50,647M vs $49,690M; adj. EPS $0.58 vs $0.50
items.take: Centene reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $50,647 million versus $49,690 million, GAAP diluted EPS of $(0.14) versus $(13.50), and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.58 versus $0.50. The health benefits ratio was 92.7%, unchanged from a year earlier. The year-ago GAAP loss makes the per-share comparison unusually wide.

items.headline: Centene lifts 2026 adj. EPS guide to above $5.20; GAAP above $3.46
items.take: Centene raised 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance by $0.40 to greater than $5.20, with GAAP diluted EPS now greater than $3.46 and total revenues of $196.5 billion to $200.5 billion. At-risk membership was 25,698,200 at Sept. 30 versus 27,968,100 a year earlier, down 8.1%. Earnings are guided higher on a smaller member base.

items.headline: Quest Q3 revenue $3,097M vs $2,816M; raises 2026 adj. EPS to $11.25-$11.35
items.take: Quest Diagnostics reported Q3 2026 net revenues of $3,097 million versus $2,816 million, reported diluted EPS of $2.78 versus $2.16, and adjusted diluted EPS of $3.00 versus $2.60. It lifted 2026 net revenue guidance to $12.065B-$12.105B from $11.95B-$12.05B. Revenue is up 10.0% year over year by our calculation.

items.headline: Hubbell Q3 net sales $1,872.5M vs $1,502.4M; adj. EPS $5.91 vs $5.17
items.take: Hubbell reported Q3 2026 net sales of $1,872.5 million versus $1,502.4 million, GAAP diluted EPS of $4.94 versus $4.77, and adjusted diluted EPS of $5.91 versus $5.17. It raised 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $20.40-$20.60 and said backlog built again in the quarter. Sales are up 24.6% by our calculation while GAAP EPS rose only 3.6%.

items.headline: Roper Q3 revenue $2.17B; adj. EPS $5.89 vs $5.14; guide raised to $22.35-$22.40
items.take: Roper Technologies reported Q3 2026 revenue of about $2.17 billion versus about $2.02 billion, GAAP diluted EPS of $4.88 versus $3.68, and adjusted diluted EPS of $5.89 versus $5.14. Full-year adjusted guidance was raised to $22.35-$22.40 from $22.15-$22.30, with Q4 guided at $5.95-$6.00.

items.headline: Repligen Q3 revenue $209.3M vs $188.8M; raises FY26 revenue to $844M-$852M
items.take: Repligen reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $209.3 million versus $188.8 million, a GAAP diluted loss per share of $(0.68) versus EPS of $0.26, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.53 versus $0.46. It raised full-year revenue guidance to $844 million-$852 million. Revenue grew 10.9% by our calculation, but GAAP results swung to a loss.

items.headline: Itron Q3 revenue $599.3M vs $581.6M; non-GAAP EPS $1.94 vs $1.54
items.take: Itron reported Q3 2026 revenue of $599.3 million versus $581.6 million, GAAP diluted EPS of $1.61 versus $1.41, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.94 versus $1.54. Q3 bookings were $482 million, backlog was $4.3 billion, and full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance is $6.72-$6.82. Backlog is roughly seven times quarterly revenue.

items.headline: Boeing Q3 revenue $24,188M vs $23,270M; diluted loss per share $0.26
items.take: Boeing reported Q3 2026 revenue of $24,188 million versus $23,270 million a year earlier, up 3.9%. GAAP diluted loss per share was $(0.26) versus $(7.14), and core loss per share (non-GAAP) was $(0.34) versus $(7.47). The year-over-year swing in per-share results is large, but the company still reported a loss for the quarter.

items.headline: Boeing: operating cash flow $1,496M, free cash flow $464M, backlog $745B
items.take: Boeing's release shows Q3 operating cash flow of $1,496 million versus $1,123 million a year earlier, and non-GAAP free cash flow of $464 million versus $238 million. It said total company backlog grew to a record $745 billion, including over 6,300 commercial airplanes. Positive free cash flow in the quarter contrasts with the per-share loss, a gap that reflects non-cash and timing items rather than a single driver.

items.headline: S&P Global Q3 revenue $3,678M vs $3,443M; GAAP diluted EPS $4.45 vs $3.54
items.take: S&P Global reported Q3 2026 revenue from continuing operations of $3,678 million versus $3,443 million, up 6.8%. GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations was $4.45 versus $3.54, and adjusted diluted EPS was $4.58 versus $4.20. Net income attributable to the company was $1,240 million versus $1,176 million, a smaller gain than the EPS change.

items.headline: S&P Global lifts 2026 adjusted EPS guide to $17.70-$17.95 from $17.50-$17.75
items.take: S&P Global's release raises 2026 total revenue growth guidance to 7.4%-8.4% from 5.9%-7.9% and adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $17.70-$17.95 from $17.50-$17.75. GAAP diluted EPS guidance moves down to $16.25-$16.50 from $16.35-$16.60. The split between higher adjusted and lower GAAP ranges shows the company's own view of how non-recurring items affect reported results.

items.headline: FOMC meeting begins today; decision Wednesday, press conference at 2:30 p.m. ET
items.take: The Federal Reserve Board's October calendar lists the two-day FOMC meeting starting today, with the meeting concluding Oct. 28 at 2:00 p.m. ET and a press conference at 2:30 p.m. ET. The calendar lists no Fed speeches or discussions for Oct. 27-31. The H.4.1 balance sheet report follows Thursday at 4:30 p.m. ET and the H.8 bank assets report Friday at 4:15 p.m. ET.

items.headline: Fed H.15: 10-year yield 5.00% and 2-year 4.69% on Oct. 23; fed funds 3.88%
items.take: The Federal Reserve's H.15 release shows the 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield at 5.00% on Oct. 23, up from 4.96% on Oct. 22, and the 2-year at 4.69% versus 4.65%. The effective federal funds rate was 3.88% on both days. The 2-year yield stood 0.81 percentage point above the effective fed funds rate, a gap computed from the release's own figures.

items.headline: RadNet to acquire ONRAD for $350M cash plus 5M shares; earnout up to $210M
items.take: RadNet agreed to acquire teleradiology provider ONRAD for a cash payment of $350 million and 5 million RadNet shares, subject to customary adjustments, plus an earnout of up to $210 million tied to 2027 target EBITDA. RadNet expects ONRAD to add $190 million to $200 million of revenue and $60 million to $65 million of adjusted EBITDA in its first year after closing. The deal is expected to close in early 2027, subject to regulatory review and closing conditions.

items.headline: TransUnion Q3 revenue $1,312.5M vs $1,169.5M; diluted EPS $0.81 vs $0.49
items.take: TransUnion reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1,312.5 million, up 12.2% from $1,169.5 million, and net income attributable to the company of $156.2 million versus $96.6 million. Diluted EPS was $0.81 versus $0.49, and adjusted diluted EPS was $1.25 versus $1.10. Adjusted EBITDA margin slipped to 35.4% from 36.3% even as Adjusted EBITDA rose to $465 million from $425 million.

items.headline: TransUnion 2026 guide: revenue $5,131M-$5,162M, adj. EPS $4.81-$4.88
items.take: TransUnion's release gives 2026 revenue guidance of $5,131 million to $5,162 million, adjusted EBITDA of $1,808 million to $1,827 million and adjusted diluted EPS of $4.81 to $4.88, and says it is raising its adjusted EPS guidance. Q3 adjusted EBITDA was $465 million versus $425 million a year earlier. The guidance ranges give a reference point for how the company sees the rest of the year.

items.headline: INNIO Q3 net sales $1,167.9M vs $742.7M; net income $109.2M vs $39.5M
items.take: INNIO reported Q3 2026 net sales of $1,167.9 million versus $742.7 million, up 57%, and net income of $109.2 million versus $39.5 million. Adjusted EBITDA was $245.4 million versus $144.2 million, a 21.0% margin, and diluted EPS was $0.15 versus $0.05. The 57% sales growth is the figure to read against the raised full-year guidance.

items.headline: INNIO lifts 2026 revenue view to $3.9B-$4.0B and adj. EBITDA to $780M-$800M
items.take: INNIO raised full-year 2026 guidance to total revenue of $3.9 billion to $4.0 billion from $3.8 billion to $3.9 billion, and adjusted EBITDA to $780 million to $800 million from $720 million to $740 million. FY2025 actuals in the release were $2.6 billion of revenue and $549 million of adjusted EBITDA. The raised ranges imply a step up from last year's base, measured on the company's own adjusted EBITDA definition.

items.headline: Smithfield Q3 sales $3,437M vs $3,747M; diluted EPS $0.23 vs $0.63
items.take: Smithfield Foods reported Q3 2026 sales of $3,437 million versus $3,747 million, down 8.3%, and net income attributable to Smithfield of $89 million versus $248 million. Diluted EPS was $0.23 versus $0.63, and adjusted diluted EPS was $0.26 versus $0.58. Adjusted operating profit was $145 million versus $310 million, with the margin falling to 4.2% from 8.3%.

items.headline: Smithfield Fresh Pork Q3 operating loss $89M vs profit $10M; Packaged Meats profit $230M
items.take: Smithfield's Packaged Meats segment grew operating profit to $230 million from $226 million on sales of $1,982 million, while Fresh Pork swung to an $89 million operating loss from a $10 million profit and Hog Production earned $34 million versus $89 million. The company said upstream segments were challenged by lower pork commodity markets. It guides 2026 total adjusted operating profit of $900 million to $1,000 million, with Packaged Meats the only segment that grew operating profit.

items.headline: Acuity agrees to acquire Parameter Technologies for $675M purchase price
items.take: Acuity Inc. announced an agreement to acquire Parameter Technologies, which operates the RLE Technologies and CellWatch brands, at a stated purchase price of $675 million. Acuity said it will fund the deal with $500 million of borrowings plus balance-sheet cash, with closing expected in the second quarter of fiscal 2027 subject to customary conditions including the HSR waiting period. The release does not say whether the price includes earnouts or debt, so the headline figure should be read as stated.

items.headline: Truelink Capital to acquire Johnson Controls' global intrusion products business
items.take: Truelink Capital signed a definitive agreement to acquire Johnson Controls' global intrusion products business, whose brands include DSC, Qolsys, PowerG, Visonic, Bentel and Sur-Gard. Financial terms were not disclosed, and closing is expected in the first half of calendar 2027, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals. Truelink's 2024 purchase of Air Distribution Technologies was also a Johnson Controls carve-out.

items.headline: Bank of Canada sets Oct. 28 rate announcement, with Monetary Policy Report
items.take: The Bank of Canada's published 2026 schedule lists a policy rate announcement on Oct. 28 at 9:45 a.m. ET. The October announcement is published concurrently with the Monetary Policy Report, as are those in January, April and July. It arrives the same day the Fed's FOMC meeting concludes.

items.headline: Amkor Q3 net sales $1,991M vs $1,987M; diluted EPS $0.76 vs $0.51
items.take: Amkor reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $1,991 million versus $1,987 million a year earlier and $1,898 million in Q2, with diluted EPS of $0.76 versus $0.51 and gross margin of 18.3%. The CEO cited record revenue in Computing and Automotive & Industrial despite expected weakness in Communications. Sales were essentially flat year over year while EPS rose about 49%, so the profit gain did not come from top-line growth.

items.headline: Amkor guides Q4 net sales $1.9B-$2.0B, EPS $0.65-$0.75; 2026 capex about $2.5B
items.take: Amkor's Q4 2026 guidance calls for net sales of $1.9 billion to $2.0 billion, gross margin of 18.0% to 19.0%, and net income of $160 million to $185 million, or $0.65 to $0.75 per diluted share. Full-year 2026 capital expenditures were updated to approximately $2.5 billion. Communications fell to 37% of Q3 sales from 51% a year earlier, a mix shift that matters for how the guide reads.

items.headline: Nucor Q3 net sales $11.25B vs $8.52B; diluted EPS $5.80 vs $2.63
items.take: Nucor reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $11,249 million versus $8,521 million a year earlier, and net earnings attributable to Nucor stockholders of $1,319 million, or $5.80 per diluted share, versus $607 million, or $2.63. Net sales were up about 32% year over year and EPS more than doubled. The results were released at 16:30 ET on Oct. 26.
items.source_name: Nucor press release via PR Newswire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Nucor steel mill shipments 7.23M tons vs 6.43M; Q4 seen in line to modestly higher
items.take: Nucor's steel mill shipments were 7,231 thousand tons in Q3 2026 versus 7,100 thousand in Q2 and 6,428 thousand in Q3 2025. The company said it expects fourth-quarter 2026 earnings to be "generally in-line with or modestly higher than the third quarter." Shipments rose about 12% from a year earlier, a smaller gain than net sales, so price and mix carried part of the revenue increase.
items.source_name: Nucor press release via PR Newswire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Cincinnati Financial Q3 net income $459M, $2.96/share vs $7.11; revenues $3,047M
items.take: Cincinnati Financial reported third-quarter 2026 total revenues of $3,047 million versus $3,726 million and net income of $459 million, or $2.96 per diluted share, versus $1,122 million, or $7.11. Non-GAAP operating income per share was $2.86 versus $2.85. The gap between GAAP and operating results points to non-operating items, most likely investment-related, as the swing factor.
items.source_name: Cincinnati Financial press release via PR Newswire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Cincinnati Financial Q3 combined ratio 90.9% vs 88.2%; book value $105.42/share
items.take: Cincinnati Financial's consolidated property casualty combined ratio was 90.9% in Q3 2026 versus 88.2% a year earlier, with current accident year catastrophe losses at 10.8% of earned premiums versus 4.4%. Book value per share was $105.42 at Sept. 30 and the company declared a cash dividend of $0.94 per share versus $0.87. Higher catastrophe losses account for a large part of the underwriting deterioration.
items.source_name: Cincinnati Financial press release via PR Newswire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Celestica Q3 revenue $5.83B vs $3.19B; GAAP diluted EPS $3.26 vs $2.31
items.take: Celestica reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $5,829.7 million versus $3.19 billion a year earlier, GAAP diluted EPS of $3.26 versus $2.31 and adjusted EPS of $3.30 versus $1.58. The release was issued at 16:17 ET on Oct. 26. Revenue rose about 82.7% on the rounded prior-year figure, so revenue growth was far larger than the rise in diluted EPS.

items.headline: Celestica lifts 2026 outlook to $21.0B revenue, adj. EPS $11.55; cuts FCF to $460M
items.take: Celestica's updated 2026 outlook calls for revenue of $21.0 billion (previous $20.5 billion) and adjusted EPS of $11.55 (previous $11.30), with adjusted operating margin unchanged at 8.4%. Free cash flow is now $460 million versus $600 million previously, which the company attributes mainly to working capital investments for 2027 growth. Q4 guidance is revenue of $6.275-$6.575 billion and adjusted EPS of $3.37-$3.57; the company holds its Investor and Analyst Day on Oct. 27.

items.headline: Brown & Brown Q3 revenue $1.725B, up 7.4%; diluted EPS $0.67 vs $0.68
items.take: Brown & Brown reported third-quarter 2026 total revenues of $1,725 million versus $1,606 million, net income attributable to the company of $240 million versus $227 million, and diluted EPS of $0.67 versus $0.68. Diluted EPS - Adjusted was $1.07 versus $1.05, with Organic Revenue growth of 1.2%. Total revenue growth outpaced organic growth, so most of the gain came from sources other than existing-book expansion.

items.headline: Dorman Q3 net sales $561.7M vs $543.7M; diluted EPS $1.98 vs $2.48
items.take: Dorman Products reported net sales of $561.7 million for the quarter ended Sept. 26, 2026, versus $543.7 million a year earlier. Diluted EPS was $1.98 versus $2.48 and adjusted diluted EPS was $2.08 versus $2.62. Net sales rose roughly 3.3% while diluted EPS fell roughly 20.2%, so earnings moved opposite to sales.
items.source_name: Dorman Products press release via GlobeNewswire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Dorman trims 2026 sales growth view to 2%-3%; adj. EPS $8.50-$8.70
items.take: Dorman now expects full-year 2026 net sales growth of 2% to 3% (prior 3% to 5%), diluted EPS of $7.95 to $8.15 (prior $7.93 to $8.23) and adjusted diluted EPS of $8.50 to $8.70 (prior $8.50 to $8.80). The sales range and the top end of the adjusted EPS range were lowered, while the low end of adjusted EPS was held.
items.source_name: Dorman Products press release via GlobeNewswire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Phillips Edison Q3 Core FFO $0.71/share vs $0.65; same-center NOI up 5.3%
items.take: Phillips Edison reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $0.49 per diluted share versus $0.20, Nareit FFO of $0.69 versus $0.64 and Core FFO of $0.71 versus $0.65. Same-center NOI rose 5.3% to $122.4 million from $116.2 million. The company raised full-year Core FFO guidance to $2.75-$2.79 per diluted share from a prior $2.73-$2.79, lifting the low end.
items.source_name: Phillips Edison press release via GlobeNewswire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Treasury calendar: 5-year note auction Oct. 27, 7-year Oct. 29, 2-year FRN Oct. 28
items.take: Treasury's tentative auction schedule lists a 5-year note auction on Tuesday, Oct. 27, a 2-year FRN and 17-week bill on Wednesday, Oct. 28, and 7-year note plus 4- and 8-week bill auctions on Thursday, Oct. 29, with the 2-, 5-year and 7-year notes and the FRN all settling Nov. 2. The schedule does not state offering sizes, which are set in separate announcements. The heavy coupon calendar coincides with the FOMC meeting on Oct. 27-28.

items.headline: The Hartford Q3 net income to common $1.32B, $4.82 per diluted share vs $3.77
items.take: The Hartford reported third-quarter 2026 net income available to common stockholders of $1,317 million, or $4.82 per diluted share, versus $1,074 million and $3.77 a year earlier; total revenues were $7,220 million versus $6,946 million. Core earnings were $956 million, or $3.50 per diluted share, versus $1,022 million and $3.59, so headline net income rose while core earnings fell. The release's own reconciliation points to a $497 million gain on commuting an asbestos and environmental cover, which helps explain why the two measures diverged.
items.source_name: The Hartford press release via Business Wire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: The Hartford lifts quarterly dividend 12% to $0.67; Mo Tooker to become CEO March 1
items.take: The Hartford said it increased its quarterly common dividend by 12% to $0.67 per share, payable January 5, 2027, to holders of record as of December 1, 2026. It also announced that Mo Tooker will succeed Christopher Swift as CEO on March 1, 2027, with Swift becoming Executive Chair. Book value per diluted share was $68.31 at Sept. 30 versus $63.86 a year earlier.
items.source_name: The Hartford press release via Business Wire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Hartford Q3 catastrophe losses $198M pre-tax vs $70M; Business Insurance combined ratio 91.3
items.take: The Hartford reported property and casualty current accident year catastrophe losses of $198 million before tax in the third quarter, primarily from tornado, wind and hail events, compared with $70 million in the third quarter of 2025. The Business Insurance combined ratio was 91.3 versus 88.8, and Personal Insurance was 93.2 versus 88.7. Underlying combined ratios, which exclude catastrophes and prior-year development, were 90.1 versus 89.4 for Business Insurance and 87.1 versus 90.0 for Personal Insurance. Personal Insurance's reported combined ratio rose by 4.5 points while its underlying ratio fell by 2.9 points.
items.source_name: The Hartford press release via Business Wire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Rambus Q3 revenue $218.3M vs $178.5M; GAAP diluted EPS $0.69 vs $0.44
items.take: Rambus reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $218.3 million versus $178.5 million a year earlier, with GAAP net income of $74.6 million versus $48.4 million and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.69 versus $0.44. By our calculation revenue rose about 22.3% year over year. Product revenue of $114.3 million, up from $93.3 million, contributed the largest dollar increase of the three revenue lines.
items.source_name: Rambus press release via Business Wire (Oct. 26, 2026)

items.headline: Rambus guides Q4 revenue $227M-$233M; GAAP diluted EPS $0.68-$0.76
items.take: Rambus' fourth-quarter 2026 outlook calls for revenue of $227 million to $233 million, including product revenue of $127 million to $133 million and royalties revenue of $68 million to $74 million.
